# MIDAS-API

> Curated, source-faithful copy of the MIDAS NX Open API (MIDAS Gen NX · Civil NX) JSON manual,
> structured for developers and AI tools. Not official: the official MIDAS API Online Manual is
> the source of truth, and actual API behaviour is not guaranteed by this repository.

Coverage: 860 official articles, 33 chapter files, 573 endpoints indexed (573 documented), 2,474 retrieval chunks. Generated by `scripts/manual_sync/build_llms.py`; do not edit by hand.

## How to use this repository

1. **When you know the URI**, run the offline lookup from the repository root. Use the URI alone to list articles. Add an exact selector or article ID to read the chosen article's methods, keys, locations and source chunks. The optional `--json` flag emits the same data for tools.

   ```sh
   python -X utf8 scripts/manual_sync/lookup.py /post/TABLE --table-type BEAMFORCE --json
   python -X utf8 scripts/manual_sync/lookup.py DESIGN/PSC/AASHTO-LRFD24/DSPSC
   python -X utf8 scripts/manual_sync/lookup.py /design/steel/KDS-41-30-2022/DREULT --article-id 57390686440345
   ```

   Other selectors are `--current-mode`, `--text-type` and `--dgncode`. Exit codes are 0 for lookup or discovery, 1 for no match, 2 for invalid arguments and 3 for ambiguous filters.
   In `endpoints.json` (`schema_version` 2), URI summaries aggregate `current` and `unlinked` articles. `legacy_methods` and `legacy_keys` contain values exclusive to legacy articles. `methods_status` is `not_listed` when no method was extracted from the non-legacy articles. For an API request, use the selected article's `methods`, `keys`, `variants` and official `url`. `locations` identifies chapter anchors and exact chunks, including generated blocks that share an anchor with the main text.

2. **You know the task, not the URI**: search `docs/index/chunks.jsonl` (one JSON object per line: `file`, `heading`, `anchor`, `source`, `endpoints`, `articles`, `jp_only`, `text`), or scan the chapter map below.
3. **Before writing code**, read [AUTHENTICATION.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dennis5882/MIDAS-API/main/docs/AUTHENTICATION.md): base URL `https://moa-engineers.midasit.com:443/gen` (Gen NX) or `/civil` (Civil NX), header `MAPI-Key`.

## What you can cite

| `source` of a chunk | Count | Meaning |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `om` | 1,584 | Official manual content organised per endpoint. Parameter descriptions are the official text (some separate tables in chapters 09, 10 and 27 still carry older translations). May include `⚠️` notes. |
| `om-verbatim` | 126 | "OM 원문 추가 필드" blocks: official Specifications rows copied verbatim. |
| `repo-example` | 764 | Python examples written by this repository. **Not official; do not cite as evidence.** |

A chunk's `articles` lists its attributed source IDs. Use the corresponding official article URL for citations. `candidate_articles` records unresolved matches. Some shared text has no article-level attribution.

## Conventions in the chapters

- Each endpoint section: Input URI → Active Methods → parameter table → JSON Schema / Response HEAD → Request / Response JSON → Python example.
- Parameter tables use `| No. | 설명 | Key | Value 타입 | 기본값 | 필수 |`. Nesting is shown with `└` (a second level adds two full-width spaces). Descriptions stay in the official language (English or Korean); notes added by this repository are in Korean.
- `⚠️` marks a typo or contradiction in the official manual, or where this copy deliberately differs, with the reason.
- `ᴶ⁾` marks items for MIDAS Civil NX JP version only; the list is `docs/manual/jp_only.json`.
- Settings requests wrap records in `"Assign"` (keyed by ID strings); actions, result tables and reports use `"Argument"`.
- Result tables share `POST/TABLE` (or a design-code `TABLE`) and are told apart by `TABLE_TYPE`.

## Other files

- [docs/manual/INDEX.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dennis5882/MIDAS-API/main/docs/manual/INDEX.md): full table of contents with design-code tables.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dennis5882/MIDAS-API/main/AGENTS.md): rules for agents that edit or maintain this repository (not needed to use it).
- [docs/index/endpoints.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dennis5882/MIDAS-API/main/docs/index/endpoints.json): URI summaries and per-article status, selectors, methods, request keys and source locations.
- [docs/index/chunks.jsonl](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dennis5882/MIDAS-API/main/docs/index/chunks.jsonl): retrieval chunks (≈3,500 characters max).
- [docs/plugin/INDEX.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dennis5882/MIDAS-API/main/docs/plugin/INDEX.md): MIDAS Plug-in tools built on this API (GUI walkthroughs, separate from the endpoint manual).
- [examples/](https://github.com/Dennis5882/MIDAS-API/tree/main/examples): Python, VBA, JavaScript and curl examples.
